{
  "problem_id": "TA-007",
  "lane_id": "openai-raw",
  "provider": "openai",
  "model_or_runtime": "OpenAI frontier reasoning-model API ensemble with long-context research agents, coding agents, retrieval infrastructure, and independently instantiated critic and verifier agents",
  "execution_posture": "non_governed",
  "estimated_input_tokens": 7500000000,
  "estimated_output_tokens": 1400000000,
  "estimated_reasoning_tokens": 18000000000,
  "estimated_candidate_branches": 1400,
  "estimated_failed_branches": 1290,
  "estimated_retries": 420,
  "estimated_search_cost": 100000,
  "estimated_governance_overhead": 0,
  "estimated_verification_cost": 550000,
  "estimated_total_cost_low": 500000,
  "estimated_total_cost_central": 2000000,
  "estimated_total_cost_high": 9000000,
  "estimated_elapsed_hours_low": 2800,
  "estimated_elapsed_hours_central": 10500,
  "estimated_elapsed_hours_high": 35000,
  "estimated_success_probability": 0.18,
  "estimated_reproduction_probability": 0.38,
  "estimated_independent_result_probability": 0.06,
  "confidence": 0.28,
  "assumptions": [
    "This is a prospective resource estimate, not a claim of observed feasibility.",
    "The target is interpreted as a publication-grade polynomial approximation-factor hardness theorem for CVP, with explicit complexity assumptions, reduction type, approximation regime, and dimension or rank parameterization.",
    "The central estimate assumes 40 to 80 parallel research agents, periodic consolidation, aggressive branch termination, and several long sequential proof-development phases.",
    "Reasoning tokens are accounted separately from ordinary visible output tokens; actual API billing may combine or price these categories differently.",
    "Costs include model inference, orchestration, retrieval, licensed literature access, storage, experiment compute, proof-checking infrastructure, and independent model-based verification.",
    "The estimate excludes ordinary institutional overhead, publication fees, and substantial human theorem-development labor; limited operator intervention for infrastructure failures is included.",
    "Literature ingestion includes foundational lattice complexity, PCP and gap-reduction techniques, prior CVP and SVP hardness results, coding-theoretic reductions, locally dense lattice constructions, and relevant post-publication corrections.",
    "Reproduction probability refers to reconstructing and independently checking a known published proof after proof-level literature access.",
    "Independent-result probability refers to obtaining the target without exposure to the decisive proof construction, while allowing access to prior background literature.",
    "Success probability refers to the planned mixed workflow producing a defensible manuscript matching the target, including verification and replication; it is not the sum of the two route-specific probabilities.",
    "No governed-lane identity hashing, budget enforcement, branch receipts, evidence-preservation controls, or policy-check accounting is included; publication-grade verification remains included."
  ],
  "uncertainty_drivers": [
    "Ambiguity over whether the requested hardness is unconditional, NP-hard under randomized reductions, quasi-NP-hard, or conditional on stronger complexity assumptions.",
    "The precise polynomial approximation exponent and whether it must be constant, explicit, or asymptotically optimized.",
    "Whether the result must apply to standard CVP in a conventional norm or may use restricted instances, preprocessing, bounded distance variants, or nonstandard norms.",
    "Potential dependence on a new PCP, coding, lattice-gadget, or locally dense lattice construction rather than recombination of established techniques.",
    "The difficulty of preserving a polynomial gap while controlling lattice dimension, bit complexity, completeness, soundness, and reduction runtime.",
    "The amount of unpublished folklore, tacit parameter knowledge, or correction history needed to reconstruct prior reductions reliably.",
    "Model performance on very long dependency chains, delicate asymptotic bookkeeping, and adversarial counterexample generation.",
    "Availability and usefulness of formal libraries for lattices, reductions, probability bounds, and complexity theory.",
    "Contamination risk when separating genuine rediscovery from reconstruction informed by the known proof.",
    "Large variance in inference pricing, context limits, parallel-agent efficiency, and the number of sequential research cycles required."
  ],
  "minimum_evidence": [
    "A precise theorem statement identifying the approximation factor, norm, input parameter, reduction model, complexity assumption, and any randomness or promise conditions.",
    "A complete reduction with polynomial-time and polynomial-bit-complexity accounting.",
    "Explicit completeness and soundness proofs establishing the claimed CVP gap.",
    "End-to-end parameter propagation showing that the approximation factor is polynomial in the intended dimension or rank measure.",
    "Proofs of every new lattice, coding, PCP, or combinatorial lemma used by the reduction.",
    "Automated arithmetic and symbolic checks for parameter inequalities, probability bounds, and asymptotic regimes.",
    "Computational experiments on small instances to test gadgets, identify omitted cases, and falsify incorrect intermediate claims, without treating experiments as proof.",
    "At least two independent critic reconstructions of the full argument from the theorem statement and cited lemmas.",
    "A clean-room replication in which a separate verifier receives the final manuscript and source references but not the originating branch transcripts.",
    "Formalization of the most failure-sensitive lemmas and parameter calculations in a proof assistant, plus machine-checkable validation of any finite computations.",
    "A dependency audit ensuring that no cited result already assumes the desired hardness conclusion or an equivalent unproved conjecture.",
    "A publication-ready manuscript containing comparison with prior work, complete proofs, reproducible computational artifacts, limitations, and a structured response to adversarial referee reports."
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "The target may require a genuinely new gap-amplification or lattice-gadget idea that current models cannot reliably originate.",
    "A polynomial approximation gap may collapse during embedding, sparsification, norm conversion, or dimension reduction.",
    "Necessary locally dense lattice or coding constructions may be unavailable with simultaneously sufficient density, explicitness, and efficient decoding properties.",
    "The strongest obtainable theorem may rely on assumptions or reduction types that do not satisfy the intended statement.",
    "Long proofs may contain correlated errors that survive model-only critic passes.",
    "Formalization may be impractical if core lattice and complexity-theory libraries are missing.",
    "Proof-level literature exposure can make a claimed independent rediscovery impossible to substantiate.",
    "API context, rate, availability, or budget limits may interrupt the long sequential chains needed for convergence.",
    "A complete result may still fail publication review because of novelty, attribution, hidden dependence on prior work, or unresolved edge cases."
  ]
}
